text.en:
Immediately upon firing:
40 Stability, -50% Recoil, and -10% Accuracy Cone Size for 0.6 seconds.

Fusion Rifles Only Receive <title 25% of the benefits [fusions] />.

<green [Controller-Only] /> Weapon fires the instant trigger pressure is applied.

enhanced (
#e Stronger Effect, duration increased to 0.76 seconds.
)
